findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: An attacker could inject malicious data into 'term->osc_string' that, when decoded and processed, could lead to OS command execution.
findings.assumptions: The 'term->osc_string' contains attacker-controlled data that is decoded and used in a way that could lead to command execution.

findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: An attacker could provide a very large 'term->osc_strlen' value, causing the allocation of excessive memory.
findings.assumptions: The 'term->osc_strlen' value is directly used to allocate memory without proper validation.
